name: Checkbox
intent: Checkbox for multi-select and confirmations. Always has a label; the label can be visually hidden.
usage: Use Checkbox for independent yes/no choices and multi-select, like agreeing to terms or picking table rows. For one choice from several, use radio buttons. Every Checkbox has a label; set hideLabel in table rows and other slots with no visible text. Indeterminate is only for a parent that reflects mixed children. See contracts/checkbox.json for the full contract.

size.note: Box 16 / 20 / 24 px, text 12 / 14 / 16 px. Without a size, a surrounding Density picks it: compact sm, default md, comfortable lg.

indeterminate.note: Shows a minus and reads as mixed, even if checked.

error.note: Red border. Show the message in a Field once Field exists.

hideLabel.note: Keeps the label for screen readers but hides it on screen.

id.note: Optional. An id is generated when omitted.

useWhen: Independent yes/no choices, like enable notifications.
Multi-select in lists and table rows.
Confirmations that are not a submit action.
doNot: Do not invent a local Checkbox.
Do not use for one choice from several.
Do not use as a submit action. Use Button.
Do not ship a Checkbox without a label. Use hideLabel instead.
a11y: Native input type=checkbox with a real label.
hideLabel keeps the label for screen readers.
Focus ring on the box for keyboard users.
The clickable input reaches 24 by 24 around the 16 and 20 boxes, so a checkbox with hideLabel is still easy to hit (WCAG 2.5.8).

examples.title: Sizes
examples.usage: md is the default. Use sm in dense tables and lg next to larger text.

examples.title: Hidden label
examples.usage: For table rows and other slots with no visible text. The label is still read by screen readers.

examples.title: Error
examples.usage: A problem on this control, like terms not accepted.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.usage: Dims the control and blocks input.

examples.title: Indeterminate
examples.usage: Only for a parent that reflects mixed children, like Select all when some rows are picked.
